## Why visit

A substantial traditional pub experience built around a succession of rooms, a tiled passage and service hatches rather than a single open space. The preserved interior is the principal attraction, but current sources also establish an active cask offering after cellar work in 2026. This deserves inclusion alongside the Peveril, not merely a photograph from outside. Set aside time to explore the room layout with a drink and notice how the bar serves people sitting away from the front counter.

## Beer

The current official site advertises cask ale. Local CAMRA reports cellar refurbishment in April 2026 and provision for eight casks; actual availability may be lower.

## Cider and perry

**Cider reported; qualification needs checking.** The operator advertises cider but no specific qualifying real-cider product was established.

## Food

Not established; do not plan a meal here without checking.

## Plan the visit

Current operation is supported by the official site and a 2026 CAMRA update. Check the present bar range; older accounts of the pub and its whisky range may be out of date.

**Getting there:** Across from Bridgewater Hall; walk from Deansgate-Castlefield, St Peter’s Square or Oxford Road.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
